Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Apply fungicides containing captan or myclobutanil. Remove and destroy infected leaves. Improve air circulation by pruning.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Apply lime sulfur sprays during dormant season.
Apple___Apple_scab.organic: Neem oil spray every 7–10 days. Baking soda solution (1 tbsp per litre).

Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Prune out infected branches 15cm below visible infection. Apply copper-based fungicide. Remove mummified fruits.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Maintain orchard sanitation. Avoid bark injuries.
Apple___Black_rot.organic: Bordeaux mixture spray. Remove all infected plant material promptly.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Apply fungicide (myclobutanil or triadimefon) from pink bud stage through 3rd cover spray.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Remove nearby juniper/cedar trees. Plant resistant apple varieties.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic: Sulfur-based sprays during early infection period.

Apple___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Plant appears healthy.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Continue regular monitoring and good orchard management.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Apply foliar fungicides (strobilurins or triazoles) at early tasseling. Rotate crops with non-host plants.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Use resistant hybrids. Avoid excessive nitrogen. Till crop residue.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.organic: Copper hydroxide spray. Crop rotation with legumes.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Apply fungicide (propiconazole or azoxystrobin) if rust appears before tasseling. Scout weekly.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids. Early planting to avoid peak spore periods.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.organic: Sulfur dust or neem oil spray at 10-day intervals.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Apply triazole or strobilurin fungicide at VT/R1 growth stage. Destroy infected crop debris.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Avoid monoculture. Ensure good drainage.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Plant appears healthy.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Continue scouting weekly for early detection of pests.

Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Apply mancozeb or myclobutanil fungicide from bud break through veraison. Remove mummified berries.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Prune to improve air circulation. Remove infected berries immediately.
Grape___Black_rot.organic: Bordeaux mixture. Copper sulfate spray before bud break.

Grape___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Plant appears healthy.

Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb every 7–10 days starting at first sign. Remove lower infected leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed. Avoid overhead irrigation.
Potato___Early_blight.organic: Copper-based fungicide. Neem oil spray weekly.

Potato___Late_blight.treatment: URGENT: Apply metalaxyl + mancozeb immediately. Remove and burn infected plants. Do not compost. Harvest early if >30% infected.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Use resistant varieties (Kufri Jyoti, Kufri Bahar). Apply preventive fungicide before monsoon.
Potato___Late_blight.organic: Copper hydroxide spray. Destroy infected haulms immediately.

Potato___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Plant appears healthy.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Monitor regularly, especially during humid weather.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper bactericide (copper hydroxide) + mancozeb. Avoid working in field when wet. Remove severely infected plants.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free transplants. Avoid overhead irrigation. Rotate crops.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic: Copper soap spray. Hydrogen peroxide solution (3%) foliar spray.

Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or copper fungicide every 7 days. Remove lower infected leaves. Avoid wetting foliage.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Stake plants for air circulation. Mulch to prevent soil splash.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Baking soda spray (1 tbsp + 1 tsp oil per litre). Neem oil weekly.

Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: URGENT: Apply metalaxyl-M + mancozeb immediately. Remove and destroy infected plants. Do not compost.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid planting near potatoes. Use resistant varieties. Apply preventive copper spray.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic: Copper hydroxide spray at first sign. Destroy infected plants.

Tomato___Leaf_Miner.treatment: Apply spinosad or abamectin insecticide. Remove and destroy heavily mined leaves.
Tomato___Leaf_Miner.prevention: Use yellow sticky traps. Install fine mesh netting.
Tomato___Leaf_Miner.organic: Neem oil spray. Release parasitic wasps (Diglyphus isaea).

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or copper fungicide. Increase ventilation in greenhouse. Reduce humidity below 85%.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Proper spacing and pruning.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic: Potassium bicarbonate spray. Improve air circulation.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply copper fungicide or chlorothalonil every 7–10 days. Remove infected lower leaves. Avoid overhead watering.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Mulch soil surface. Practice 2–3 year crop rotation.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic: Copper soap spray. Remove infected leaves promptly.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.treatment: Apply miticide (abamectin or bifenazate). Spray undersides of leaves. Increase humidity around plants.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Avoid water stress. Remove weeds. Avoid dusty conditions.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic: Neem oil spray. Release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis). Water spray to dislodge mites.

Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Apply azoxystrobin or chlorothalonil fungicide. Remove heavily infected leaves.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Improve plant spacing. Avoid leaf wetness.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: URGENT: No cure. Remove and destroy infected plants immediately to prevent spread. Control whitefly vector with imidacloprid or thiamethoxam.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Use TYLCV-resistant varieties. Install reflective mulch. Use insect-proof nets.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic: Yellow sticky traps for whiteflies. Neem oil spray. Remove infected plants.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No chemical cure. Remove infected plants. Disinfect tools with bleach solution. Control aphid vectors.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Use certified virus-free seeds. Wash hands before handling plants.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic: Remove infected plants. Control aphids with neem oil. Avoid tobacco near tomatoes.

Tomato___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Plant appears healthy.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Continue regular monitoring and balanced fertilisation.

Rice___Leaf_Blast.treatment: Apply tricyclazole or isoprothiolane fungicide at first sign. Drain field temporarily. Avoid excess nitrogen.
Rice___Leaf_Blast.prevention: Use blast-resistant varieties (Jaya, IR64). Balanced fertilisation.
Rice___Leaf_Blast.organic: Silicon fertiliser improves resistance. Trichoderma spray.

Rice___Brown_Spot.treatment: Apply mancozeb or iprodione fungicide. Ensure adequate potassium supply.
Rice___Brown_Spot.prevention: Balanced NPK fertilisation. Avoid water stress.
Rice___Brown_Spot.organic: Potassium silicate spray. Neem cake soil application.

Rice___Neck_Blast.treatment: URGENT: Apply tricyclazole at booting and heading stage. Act fast — this can destroy entire yield.
Rice___Neck_Blast.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Avoid heavy nitrogen at panicle initiation.
